def parse_grids(tx, n):
 out=[]
 for kind in ('input','output'):

  mt=re.search(pat,tx)
  if not mt: raise ValueError(kind)
  lines=mt.group(1).strip().splitlines()
  out.append([list(map(int,line.split())) for line in lines])
 return out
